hero.zh: 镜头路线就是阅读顺序。
hero.en: The camera route is the reading order.

intro.zh: 每次停靠都交付可检索的信息；路线结束时，空间关系和事实证据同时成立。
intro.en: Every stop delivers searchable information; at arrival, spatial relationships and factual evidence agree.

title.zh: 先在房间尺度理解作品。
title.en: Meet the work at room scale.

body.zh: 镜头交代距离、邻近物和仍未走完的路径。
body.en: The camera establishes distance, neighbouring objects, and the route still ahead.

title.en: Move close enough to read the surface.

body.zh: 第二停靠点只改变距离与角度，用细节解释制作方法。
body.en: The second stop changes distance and angle to explain how the object was made.

title.zh: 最后停在可检索的证据。

body.zh: 标题、材料、年份和结论回到普通 DOM 文本。
body.en: Title, material, year, and conclusion return to ordinary DOM text.
